purpose: Verify the exact frozen LiveBench IF inference adapter can traverse the full private Brain runtime dependency closure on a synthetic zero-case request, and persist an exact zero-case diagnostic receipt on failure.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD:canonical/runtime/astra_runtime.py)" = "7f5d16b1db69cb620954bc778e0ba6e15e687b75"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD:canonical/runtime/root2_livebench_if_astra_inference_adapter_v1.py)" = "7e3885fa7a6e56df656c066e0a8f17cfa21424e7"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD:canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py)" = "4b61fe911471854ec15c7900816f61e9e55f602e"
python - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, traceback
from canonical.runtime import root2_livebench_if_astra_inference_adapter_v1 as a
evidence=pathlib.Path("canonical/astra_runtime/evidence/LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_TRANSITIVE_RUNTIME_CLOSURE_20261004_V1.json")
req={
  "benchmark_id":"LIVEBENCH_IF_2026_06_25",
  "task_id":"SYNTHETIC_ZERO_CASE_INFERENCE",
  "allowed_tools":[],
  "task_payload":{"instruction":"Reply with exactly SYNTHETIC_OK."},
}
base={
  "schema":"PROJECT_BRAIN_LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_TRANSITIVE_RUNTIME_CLOSURE_DIAGNOSTIC_V1",
  "terminal_case_content_read":False,
  "terminal_cases_consumed":0,
  "paid_external_model_or_api_used":False,
}
try:
    out=a.infer(req)
    assert out["status"]=="PASS__MODEL_INDEPENDENT_BRAIN_RESPONSE", out
    assert out["cognition_dependency_class"]=="MODEL_INDEPENDENT", out
    assert out["model_dependency_count"]==0, out
    assert str(out["answer"]).strip(), out
    receipt={**base,
      "status":"PASS",
      "cognition_dependency_class":out["cognition_dependency_class"],
      "model_dependency_count":out["model_dependency_count"],
      "answer_nonempty":True,
    }
    evidence.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    evidence.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_ZERO_CASE_PASS")
    print(json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True))
except Exception as exc:
    receipt={**base,
      "status":"FAIL",
      "exception_type":type(exc).__name__,
      "exception_message":str(exc),
      "traceback":traceback.format_exc()[-12000:],
    }
    evidence.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    evidence.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
    print("LIVEBENCH_PRIVATE_ZERO_CASE_FAIL")
    print(json.dumps(receipt,sort_keys=True))
    raise
PY
